media.title: Myron Gardner called Klay Thompson a ‘bum’ and ‘trash’, now they’re Heat teammates (with no hard feelings)
media.description: The “bum” is now a teammate. For the past week, the player he had called “trash” has been lining up alongside during Miami Heat drill work. The story of Myron Gardner v. Klay Thompson.
